worldcombat.skill.hydropump.summary: Fires a whole column of water at the target: the impact bursts open, knocks the main target back and douses it, and washes over the ring around the landing point. Long wind-up, expensive, and the line scatters - but one shot drenches a whole patch. Deluge form is wider and slower; pressure form is narrower and heavier.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.use.0: Knock a target back and douse it from range
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.use.1: Douse a cluster standing beside the target in one shot
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.use.2: Hand the soaked identity to another move (e.g. Hydro Cannon) for its bonus
The torrent strikes the main target for %1$s special damage.
The column has a %1$s block hit radius, travels at %2$s blocks/tick and reaches %3$s blocks; the line scatters by up to ±%4$s, less the higher the Sp. Atk.
On a hit it knocks the main target about %1$s blocks along the column.
The splash spreads %2$s blocks from the landing point; every foe in it takes %1$s backwash damage and is doused for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.deluge.on: Deluge form: backwash radius x1.5, backwash power x1.2, dousing x1.25 and scatter x1.4; costs torrent power x0.82, speed x0.9, range -2 blocks, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.deluge.off: Pressure form: torrent power x1.08, push x1.15, a tighter line and speed x1.05; costs backwash radius x0.85.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.growth.0: From level %1$s the torrent power rises to %2$s and the backwash radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.growth.1: From level %1$s the torrent power rises to %2$s, the range to %3$s blocks and the dousing to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.preference.d: On: backwash radius x1.5, backwash power x1.2, dousing x1.25 and scatter x1.4, for drenching a patch; costs torrent power x0.82, speed x0.9, range -2 blocks, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (pressure form): power x1.08, push x1.15 and a tighter line, at the cost of backwash radius x0.85, hitting only what stands ahead.
worldcombat.skill.hydropump.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target below three tenths health ranks lower, saving the heavy shot for something that can take it instead of wasting PP on a dying foe; off: finish low-health targets with it.
